settings.card.websites-you-stay-signed-i: Websites you stay signed in to
documents.intro.your-own-documents-kept-: Your own documents, kept on this computer so the assistant can quote them. Word files, spreadsheets, slide decks, OpenDocument files, e-books, rich text, web pages, notes, tables, plain text and PDFs are all read here. A PDF that is pictures of text has no words to lift out, and says so.
documents.card.add-a-file-from-your: Add a file from your workspace
skills.intro.a-skill-is-a-page: A skill is a page of written instructions your assistant can follow — how you like a letter laid out, the steps for a monthly report. It knows the name of every skill you keep here, and reads the one it needs. A skill never grants permission to do anything; your rules still decide that.
skills.card.share-a-skill-or-open: Share a skill, or open one someone sent you
schedules.intro.tasks-your-assistant-sta: Tasks your assistant starts on its own: once, every so often, or at the same time each day. Branch Agent has to be running for any of them to happen. If the computer was asleep, the missed times become one task the next time it looks; nothing that failed is tried again by itself. The answer can be sent on to a chat you have already connected.
procedures.intro.a-saved-set-of-steps: A saved set of steps your assistant can repeat exactly, with the answer you expect written down beside it. Checking one does the steps for real; replaying one first makes sure everything it needs is still where it was.
procedures.intro.a-flow-is-a-list: A flow is a list of steps the app works through on its own. Here is what each saved flow does, step by step, and where it has got to.
specialists.intro.assistants-that-do-one: Assistants that do one job and are allowed to touch only what that job needs — the one that tidies your invoices cannot open your photographs. A new one has to pass the checks written into it before you can switch it on.
memory.intro.everything-your-assistant-h: Everything your assistant has been told to remember, and everything you have already talked about. Nothing here leaves this computer.
memory.card.repeats-disagreements-and-fa: Repeats, disagreements and facts you never use
runs.intro.every-task-your-assistant-has: Every task your assistant has done, newest first. Open one to see each step it took, what came back, anything that went wrong, and what it cost.
usage.intro: Ce que votre assistant a fait ce mois-ci, ce que cela a coûté, et les limites que vous avez posées. Les chiffres sont calculés sur cet ordinateur à partir de vos propres tâches.
usage.card.limitPurpose: Arrêter de lancer de nouvelles tâches une fois atteint un nombre de mots, un montant, ou l'un ou l'autre. Laissez une case vide pour ne pas l'utiliser.
